title_original: Vanessa Ferlito, John Carroll Lynch And Ted Levine Join Denzel Washington In New Thriller From Christopher McQuarrie And United Artists

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: Vanessa Ferlito , John Carroll Lynch , and Ted Levine are set to join in Amazon MGM Studios’ and United Artists’ untitled Christopher McQuarrie-helmed thriller alongside previously announced stars Denzel Washington , Teyonah Parris and Miles Caton.
The film, which is penned by Scott Barkan and Gregg Zehentner, will be released in theaters on October 1.

The plot centers on a former police detective serving a life sentence who is diagnosed with terminal brain cancer. Granted compassionate release with six months to live, he returns home to the estranged daughter he left behind and a grandson he never knew existed. He only wants to make amends and forget his dark past, but his dark past has not forgotten him.

blocks.text: McQuarrie will also produce alongside Heather McQuarrie along with Stuber and Nick Nesbitt, who produce through United Artists; Joseph Restaino for Hungry Bull Productions; Reza Moheet and Norman Aladjem for Mainstay Entertainment; Katia Washington; and Tommy Harper. Hungry Bull’s Tony Stopperan, Mainstay’s Tim Honigman and Joe Guest will serve as executive producers.

Ferlito can be seen as a series regular in Chuck Lorre’s series for HBO Max, Bookie , opposite Sebastian Maniscalco. She also appeared in Netflix’s limited series Griselda opposite Sofia Vergara. She recently completed a long-running series regular role on the CBS series NCIS: New Orleans opposite Scott Bakula, and can be seen on the USA Network crime drama Graceland from creator Jeff Eastin. She is represented by Alchemy Entertainment and Innovative Artists.
Lynch can currently be seen in the most recent season of Ryan Murphy’s American Horror Story as well as last spring’s The Beauty . He is represented by Suskin/Karshan Management and SRDA.

Levine can currently be seen in Netflix’s Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen , created by Haley Z. Boston and executive produced by Matt and Ross Duffer. On television, he recently appeared in Apple TV+’s Cape Fear , executive produced by Martin Scorsese and Steven Spielberg. He is best known for his eight critically acclaimed seasons on USA Network’s Monk and returned for Peacock’s Mr. Monk’s Last Case: A Monk Movie . Levine is represented by Kass Management.
